findings.text: follow-on: the terminal-series-reduction assertion compares the fixture's own construction -- tests/test_coupled_plant.py:91 builds coil_inductance as series.T @ matrix[:n_section,:n_section] @ series and :95 sets section_inductance=matrix[:n_section,:n_section], and coupled_plant copies both through unchanged -- so both sides of the allclose derive from the same test matrix and the assertion moves with the fixture rather than the change; only a dropped or reordered section pass-through can fail it, and docs/evidence/fragments/iter-passive-plasma-circuit/coupled-plant-sections.html:3 concedes the 0.000e+00 is 'exact, since the terminals are formed by that same reduction'.

follow-on: the real-set reduction assertion has the same constructed-equality shape -- :316 builds coil_inductance as series.T @ matrix[:n_section,:n_section] @ series and :320 sets section_inductance=matrix[:n_section,:n_section] from the same matrix -- so the logged 'series-reduction max relative error = 0.000e+00' in real-set.log measures the fixture's invariant, not the plant, and cannot redden while the two pass-through fields stay consistent.

follow-on: the negative control perturbs a copy inside the test (:218 perturbed[0,0] *= 1.5) and asserts only that two arrays it builds itself differ (:220), never calling coupled_plant with the perturbed section_inductance, so the assertion is true for any plant; the out-of-suite control at negative-control.log carries EXIT=1 but its only failing artifact is a bare traceback with no test id, so it demonstrates the invariant's sensitivity rather than the change's reddening.

follow-on: _cache_digest updates on section_coil, section_inductance and section_resistance but not on section_passive_mutual or section_names, which are inputs to stored outputs -- mode_section_coupling is computed from section_passive_mutual at :218 and section_names is stored at :241 -- so two machines differing only in those fields collide on the same digest and the cached plant returns mode_section_coupling/section_names belonging to the other machine.
